presets.label: Romantic swell
presets.hint: Love scenes and reunions: a slow build into one big arrival (put an arrive hit on the moment)

fields.style: romantic film score, lush strings and solo french horn, late-romantic harmony, no drums

shape.name: intro
shape.words: solo cello melody over sustained divisi violas, harp arpeggios, no percussion

shape.name: build
shape.words: violins take the melody an octave up, horns sustain underneath, a suspended cymbal roll into the arrival

shape.name: climax
shape.words: the full string section in octaves on the melody, solo horn countermelody, timpani on the downbeat

shape.name: release
shape.words: strings thin to one sustained chord, a harp glissando settles, the horn alone on the last phrase

presets.label: Tension underscore
presets.hint: Suspense under dialogue: sits low and creeps up, never resolves (good under a scene that ends on a question)

fields.style: dark suspense underscore, low strings and pulses, minimal, unresolved

shape.name: intro
shape.words: cellos and basses pulse repeated eighth notes on one low pitch, sul tasto, a soft low piano note every bar

shape.name: build
shape.words: the ostinato climbs a semitone at a time, violins enter on a high held tremolo, muted brass swell and fall away, a bass drum heartbeat

shape.name: transition
shape.words: the ostinato stops, everything held on an unresolved cluster chord, no resolution

presets.label: Light comedy
presets.hint: Playful scenes and capers: short phrases with gaps, so the music can stop dead for a joke (drop hits)

fields.style: light comedic orchestral score, pizzicato and woodwinds, bouncy, transparent

shape.name: intro
shape.words: pizzicato strings and staccato bassoon on a bouncing two-note figure, a woodblock on the off-beats

shape.name: build
shape.words: clarinet and piccolo trade the tune in short phrases with rests between, pizzicato basses walk, light brushed snare

shape.name: climax
shape.words: all the woodwinds and the strings pizzicato together, a glockenspiel and a cymbal tap on the button

shape.name: outro
shape.words: the bassoon alone on the figure, slowing, one last pizzicato pluck

presets.label: Action chase
presets.hint: Chases and fights: relentless drive, accents for cuts and impacts (accent hits)

fields.style: driving action score, string ostinato, brass and taiko drums, relentless

shape.name: intro
shape.words: a driving sixteenth-note ostinato in the low strings, low toms in a syncopated pattern

shape.name: build
shape.words: the ostinato rises an octave, brass stabs on the off-beats, taiko drums and snare join

shape.name: climax
shape.words: horns and trombones in unison on the theme over the ostinato, crash cymbals on each phrase, taiko hits

shape.name: outro
shape.words: a brass stab and a timpani hit, then the ostinato alone thinning out

presets.label: Sad and tender
presets.hint: Loss, goodbyes, a quiet realisation: sparse and close, the cello as a voice

fields.style: intimate sad score, solo piano and cello, sparse, a lot of space

shape.name: intro
shape.words: solo piano, a slow broken-chord figure in the middle register, long rests, sustain pedal

shape.name: build
shape.words: a solo cello takes the melody over the piano, soft sustained violas enter beneath

shape.name: release
shape.words: cello and piano alone again, the melody's last phrase left unresolved, a final low piano note

presets.label: Wonder and awe
presets.hint: A first sight of something vast or magical: shimmer, then a slow rise to an open, bright chord

fields.style: magical wonder score, celesta, harp and choir, bright open harmony

shape.name: intro
shape.words: celesta and harp arpeggios, high violin harmonics shimmering, no bass

shape.name: build
shape.words: a wordless choir swells in on long chords, horns on a rising fifth, the strings in a long crescendo

shape.name: climax
shape.words: full choir and orchestra on a bright open major chord, a timpani roll, cymbal swell

shape.name: outro
shape.words: the celesta alone over the held choir chord

presets.label: Heist jazz
presets.hint: Plans, sneaking, cool characters at work: a walking bass groove that can carry a montage

fields.style: cool 1960s heist jazz, upright bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet, vibraphone

shape.name: intro
shape.words: upright bass alone walking a minor riff, finger snaps on two and four

shape.name: build
shape.words: brushed drums enter, a muted trumpet takes the melody, vibraphone comping chords

shape.name: climax
shape.words: saxophones and trombones hit the riff in unison, ride cymbal, the trumpet open

shape.name: outro
shape.words: bass and brushes alone, a last muted trumpet note, a soft cymbal

presets.label: Horror drone
presets.hint: Dread before a scare: a low drone and texture, one stinger (put an accent hit on the scare)

fields.style: horror score, low drones, extended string techniques, dissonant, no melody

shape.name: intro
shape.words: a very low drone in the contrabasses and a sub synth, distant scrapes of bowed metal

shape.name: build
shape.words: col legno taps in irregular clusters, string glissandi creeping upward, a slow bass drum heartbeat

shape.name: sting
shape.words: a sudden fortissimo stinger: a brass cluster, a piano slammed in the low register, a cymbal crash

shape.name: outro
shape.words: back to the drone, a single high violin harmonic

presets.label: Triumphant finale
presets.hint: Victory, the end credits, the team walking out together: everything plays

fields.style: triumphant orchestral finale, brass fanfare, full orchestra and choir

shape.name: intro
shape.words: a snare roll and timpani building, low strings on a pedal note

shape.name: build
shape.words: the horns call the main theme, strings drive in sixteenths beneath

shape.name: climax
shape.words: full orchestra: trumpets and horns on the fanfare, cymbals, the choir on the last phrase, timpani on every downbeat

shape.name: outro
shape.words: a final held major chord, a timpani roll and a cymbal crash

presets.label: Lullaby waltz
presets.hint: Childhood, memory, a gentle bedtime scene: a music box in three

fields.style: gentle lullaby waltz, music box, soft strings, harp, nostalgic

shape.name: intro
shape.words: a music box alone on a simple high melody

shape.name: build
shape.words: strings enter on a gentle waltz accompaniment, bass on one and chords on two and three, harp doubling the melody

shape.name: release
shape.words: the music box slows, the strings fade out, one last celesta note

presets.label: Pop ballad
presets.hint: A piano-led love song, verse to chorus twice with a bridge: add each section's lyrics in the inspector

fields.style: piano pop ballad, emotional vocal, warm piano, strings in the chorus

shape.name: intro
shape.words: solo piano chords

shape.name: verse
shape.words: piano and close lead vocal, soft bass, no drums

shape.name: pre-chorus
shape.words: a string pad comes in, a building tom fill

shape.name: chorus
shape.words: full band: drums, bass, piano, string pad, backing harmonies

shape.name: bridge
shape.words: down to piano and voice, then building back with the strings

shape.name: chorus
shape.words: the last chorus bigger: full drums, strings soaring, stacked harmonies

shape.name: outro
shape.words: piano alone, slowing, the last chord held

presets.label: Upbeat pop
presets.hint: A bright dance-pop song: verse, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge; add each section's lyrics in the inspector

fields.style: upbeat dance pop, four-on-the-floor, bright synths, catchy vocal hook

shape.name: intro
shape.words: a synth arpeggio and a four-on-the-floor kick

shape.name: verse
shape.words: kick and bass, muted clean guitar, sparse; the lead vocal up front

shape.name: pre-chorus
shape.words: a snare build, claps and a white-noise riser

shape.name: chorus
shape.words: everything: full drums, driving bass, bright synth chords, stacked vocals on the hook

shape.name: bridge
shape.words: half-time drums, the synths filtered down, then opening up

shape.name: chorus
shape.words: the hook again, an extra vocal ad-lib over it

shape.name: outro
shape.words: the drums drop out, the synth arpeggio alone to the end
